equity.level_reason: Sexual behavior (MSM), sex and age only describe the four patients who make up the case series; no group-specific results or equity framing.

level_alternative.reason: MSM status could be read as a descriptor of the cases rather than a population definition, which would give level 1.

ev.q: All four patients were cisgender men aged 30–39 years who reported recent sexual contact with other men.
